title: Chala hai karbala ko
body:
chala hai karbala ko karwan aahista aahista
alam ke cha rahi hai badliyan aahista aahista
<<DIVIDER>>
ali akbar jawan ki qasam mud kar kar zara dekho
chali aati hai peeche peeche maa aahista aahista
chala hai karbala ko…
<<DIVIDER>>
pidar ki quwwate bardaasht ka tha dhyan akbar ko
badi mushkil se li angdaiyan aahista aahista
chala hai karbala ko…
<<DIVIDER>>
badan sab choor tha zakhmon se qasim ka dame murdan
badi mushkil se li hichkiyan aahista aahista
chala hai karbala ko…
<<DIVIDER>>
kinaare nehr ke abbas aaye to salaami ko
nikal aayi thi saari machliyan aahista aahista
chala hai karbala ko…
